title: Employee Project Details — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
One project within an employee's project assignment. Its dates must fall within the assignment's dates.

On a saved record, Calculate Work Days shows two counts for the project's dates. Work Days adds up the approved working days, public holidays and rest days in the employee's time register. Calendar Days is every day from the start date to the end date, both included. Neither is stored.

fields.label: EmployeeProject
fields.html: What it is. The employee's project assignment.

fields.label: Project
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Project master data.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Its dates cannot overlap another record for the same employee project and project.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.

fields.label: Percentage
fields.html:
What it is. The share of pay charged to this project.

Example. 60

Why it matters. Used with the Percentage method: must be above 0 and up to 100, and the projects together cannot exceed 100. Each costed pay line's number and amount are multiplied by it.
